entities.summary: Farhang-e-Asifiya is an Urdu-to-Urdu dictionary compiled by Syed Ahmad Dehlvi. It has more than 60,000 entries in four volumes. It was first published in January 1901 by the Rifah-e-Aam Press in Lahore.
